name: LAB - PowerShell EncodedCommand execution
description: Detects PowerShell started with an encoded command (-EncodedCommand / -enc / -e), a common technique to hide script content (MITRE T1059.001, T1027). LAB PoC rule deployed disabled through Git and Ansible.
query: event.category : "process" and event.type : "start" and process.name : ("powershell.exe" or "pwsh.exe") and process.args : ("-e" or "-ec" or "-enc" or "-Enc" or "-encodedcommand" or "-EncodedCommand")
